model.note: Google's TTS page (read via Muse, 2026-10-27) documents the Gemini 3.8 models as the current ones: 3.8 Flash for studio-grade narration and stable long-form voice, 3.8 Flash-Lite as the cheap high-volume option, and 3.1 Flash Preview as the older model. Confirmed live on 2026-10-27: `gemini-3.8-flash-tts` is listed for this key (doctor --online --live) and successfully produced all three audition samples via the Interactions API.

style: Maintain the exact American male voice identity and pitch without variation. Deliver with the casual, authoritative realism of a native American financial podcaster speaking one-on-one with a client. Use natural American inflections, unhurried measured pacing, and grounded, controlled expression.
styleRules: The voice identity is fixed: the top-level style (or the registers prefix in per-scene mode) is the same for every scene of every episode.
The text field is spoken verbatim: no stage directions in it, no square or round bracket cues.
Never use hyphens or dashes in spoken text: the model can read them aloud as 'minus'. The tool also strips them; the script gate flags them.
Only the tags in request.inlineTags (<short pause>, <long pause>, <breath>, <sigh>); sound effects come from the sound plan, not the voice. <breath> and <sigh> are unverified by ear.
Never ask the model to 'keep the voice steady' (documented to increase drift).
Registers (per-scene mode only) describe delivery nuance. Age, gender and accent live in the fixed identity prefix, never in a register.

chunking._comment: maxCharsPerRequest applies to one scene. singleTakeMaxChars is the whole episode in one request; Google's documented limits (input about 8,192 tokens, one response about 8.5 minutes of audio, one page says 5,000 characters per job) are NOT yet proven for a full 10 to 15 minute episode: run the 3-scene check in docs/STATUS.md first, and use per-scene mode if the live service refuses.

request.inlineTagsNote: <short pause> and <long pause> are documented for gemini-3.8-flash-tts. <breath> and <sigh> are UNVERIFIED by ear: if the model speaks them or they sound wrong, remove them here. Square-bracket directions are always refused. The script gate caps tag density.

registers.status: UNVERIFIED by ear. Used only in per-scene mode; single-take uses the one top-level style.

byId.hook: Engaged, clear, focused delivery, natural pauses.

registers.note: A scene with no delivery uses the top-level style (documentary, owner-approved). A scene with delivery uses prefix + register so the voice character stays the same across scenes.
